Assalamualeykum Mufti Saab, We are writing to you from Kinshasa, The Democratic Republic of Congo. There are some Masail we would like to know regarding Jumma prayers. There is a big company here in Kinshasa where many of our brothers (Sunni) work, and they reside in the same compound of the company. The owner of the company is a Muslim also (Sunni), he has built a very small masjid / Ibadad khana for the brothers working in the company to pray namaz. We got to know from the brothers residing there that there is no 5 times Azaan that gets called out and no 5 times Namaaz that takes place, it only takes place sometimes. And the masjid does not totalize 40 people in prayers. The owner of the company thinks that there are 5 times prayers with azan taking place in his company, whereas there isn?t. The Owner of the company does not reside in the company compound, and he spends a lot of time out of the country. Outside the compound nearby, there is a masjid (8-10 minutes walking distance) where 5 times namaz takes place with Azaan, and Jumma prayers aswell. The question is Mufti saab, does the Masjid in the company have the right to conduct Jumma Namaz, is the Jumma namaz accepted under the above circumstances? 2152 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 51422 Country: India Title: I want to go to my office just after the farz Friday salah. Can I offer all sunnat and nafl namaz before the Juma 2 rakaat farz? Question: I want to go to my office just after the farz Friday salah. Can I offer all sunnat and nafl namaz before the Juma 2 rakaat farz? Answer ID: 51422 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 572/468/B=04/1435) You should perform two rakat as Tahiyat al-Masjid and then 4 rakat as Sunnat Muakkadah before Fardh Salah of Jumuah. After Jumuah, first perform 4 rakat Sunnat Muakkadah and then two rakat Sunnat. Then, you should go to office. The later Sunnah salah may not be offered before Jumuah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
